text.content: CWAM-COSMOS3-B5-VOM-PROBE-R3-20260817 - structurally conditioned visual memory probe

Test whether fixed-scale per-layer memory cross-attention and FiLM, a memory-only future-action objective, and adjacent-frame object-slot correspondence make aligned cross-replan memory causally useful to the B4-warm action expert.

Focused tests and BF16 GPU smoke pass; eight-B200 training completes 500 finite optimizer steps and saves a complete checkpoint; slot mean absolute off-diagonal cosine is below 0.95; temporal and memory-only action auxiliary losses are finite; on the identical 2048-sample held-out stream and seed, aligned-history main action loss is at least 1% lower than both zero and shuffled interventions. Auxiliary loss alone cannot pass the gate.
base c762c793b1fccd7f3d43dc2220d4b0f6685b8a44; implementation commit pending validation

R2 competitive 8-slot memory plus per-layer fixed-scale 0.25 memory cross-attention/FiLM; memory-only future-action loss weight 0.25 with 50-step warmup; adjacent-frame temporal correspondence weight 0.05; B4 warm start; train strong_action_expert; 500 steps; batch 64/rank; DP8; matched none/zero/shuffle validation.
RoboCasa365 B4 processed split plus 1,143,698-record triple-view Wan latent cache and completed episode-safe three-frame visual-history sidecar.
Eight-rank R3 B4-warm probe with strong_action_expert optimizer scope, followed by exact-checkpoint validation-only none, zero, and shuffle cells on the same 2048-sample stream.
pyrogpucompute1; 8 x NVIDIA B200 183359 MiB; batch 64 per rank; effective global batch 512.

Aligned/zero/shuffle main action losses and relative gains; memory-only action loss; temporal correspondence loss; slot cosine and diversity; conditioning residual RMS; finite gradients; step time; GPU memory, utilization, and power.

R2 prevented slot collapse but the B4 action path could still ignore aligned memory. R3 injects memory after every action layer with a fixed residual scale, shares those conditioners with an auxiliary decoder that cannot read text/current-image/proprio context, and predicts adjacent object-slot state. The terminal decision still uses the main-policy none/zero/shuffle intervention gate rather than auxiliary metrics.
